facts.fact: NITA-U said the UGHub integration platform lets institutions verify citizens' identities against NIRA's national identification registry in real time.
NITA-U said UGHub connects NIRA's registry to more than 150 ministries, departments and agencies, plus banks and telecommunications companies, for identity verification.

UGA.note: Nothing on civil register and ID links.
No count or share of people enrolled given.
Children get NINs by later registration; no number at birth stated.
Nothing on who operates or owns the ID system.
Verification by institutions is stated, but no public register keyed on the NIN.

facts.fact: NIRA runs a national identification registry issuing National Identification Numbers and identity cards, free of charge, and it announced a December 2026 exercise to register school-going children without NINs.
